def firstpos_all(i):
    m=M1[i]
    if m[0]=='G': a=gl[m[1]]['answer']
    else: a=fid[m[1]]['answer']
    na=len(tok.encode(a,add_special_tokens=False).ids); return L2[i]-2-na
FP=[firstpos_all(i) for i in range(len(M1))]
for name,src in [('h18',H2[18]),('h24',H2[24]),('h28',H2[28]),('a20',A2[20]),('a26',A2[26])]:
    X=np.stack([getvec(src,i,FP[i]) for i in range(len(M1))]); mu=X.mean(0); Xc=X-mu
    Xn=Xc/np.linalg.norm(Xc,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    S=Xn@Xn.T
    # wording generalization: for V texts, nearest neighbor among other V texts (excluding self)
    vi=np.array(idx_V); Sv=S[np.ix_(vi,vi)].copy(); np.fill_diagonal(Sv,-9)
    nn=vi[Sv.argmax(1)]; acc=np.mean([M1[a][1]==M1[b][1] for a,b in zip(vi,nn)])
    same=np.mean([S[a,b] for a in vi for b in vi if a!=b and M1[a][1]==M1[b][1]])
    diff=np.mean([S[a,b] for a in vi for b in vi if M1[a][1]!=M1[b][1] and fid[M1[a][1]]['kind']==fid[M1[b][1]]['kind']])
    # V vs O same fact same wording
    vo=np.mean([S[i,j] for c in oc for i in idxV0 for j in idxO[c] if M1[i][1]==M1[j][1]])
    oo=np.mean([S[i,j] for c1 in oc for c2 in oc if c1<c2 for i in idxO[c1] for j in idxO[c2] if M1[i][1]==M1[j][1]])
    print(name,'NN-fact acc %.2f | cos same-fact diff-wording %.3f | same-kind diff-fact %.3f | V-O same Q %.3f | O-O same Q %.3f'%(acc,same,diff,vo,oo))

D4='/work/fwd_4'
tid4=np.load(D4+'/token_ids.npy'); tlp4=np.load(D4+'/token_logprobs.npy')
L4=[(tid4[i]>=0).sum() for i in range(len(TC))]
H4={l:np.load(f'{D4}/hidden_{l}.npy',mmap_mode='r') for l in [26,28,30]}
H3_28=np.load(D3+'/hidden_28.npy',mmap_mode='r')
def predpos(L,ans):
    na=len(tok.encode(ans,add_special_tokens=False).ids); return list(range(L-2-na,L-1-1))  # predicting positions (na of them)
# check ctx answer logprobs
for fmt in 'AB':
    ii=[i for i,m in enumerate(MC) if m[2]==fmt]
    print(fmt,'ctx total ans lp mean %.3f'%np.mean([tlp4[i,[p+1 for p in predpos(L4[i],fid[MC[i][0]]['ans_tf'])]].sum() for i in ii]))
# map: train text j in TV3 (fid,qi) -> ctx indices
cidx={(m[0],m[1],m[2]):i for i,m in enumerate(MC)}
cosAB=[];nrm=[];hn=[]
for j,m in enumerate(MV3):
    f=fid[m[0]]; pn=predpos(L3[j],f['ans_tf'])
    iA=cidx[(m[0],m[1],'A')]; iB=cidx[(m[0],m[1],'B')]
    pa=predpos(L4[iA],f['ans_tf']); pb=predpos(L4[iB],f['ans_tf'])
    assert (tid4[iA,[p+1 for p in pa]]==tid3[j,[p+1 for p in pn]]).all()
    h0=np.asarray(H3_28[j,pn],dtype=np.float32); dA=np.asarray(H4[28][iA,pa],dtype=np.float32)-h0; dB=np.asarray(H4[28][iB,pb],dtype=np.float32)-h0
    cosAB+=list((dA*dB).sum(1)/np.linalg.norm(dA,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(dB,axis=1)); nrm+=list(np.linalg.norm(dA,axis=1)); hn+=list(np.linalg.norm(h0,axis=1))
print('cos(dA,dB) mean %.3f'%np.mean(cosAB), '|dA| mean %.1f'%np.mean(nrm), '|h28| mean %.1f'%np.mean(hn))

    Rt=R.clone(); Rt[torch.from_numpy(first_mask)]*=s
    sw=w.sqrt().unsqueeze(1)
    Zt=solve_stack(Kp*sw,Kf,ev27,mu,eps,beta)   # Zt computed with weighted keys

def risk(Zt,scale,alpha=1.07):

    flipsG=[];flipsO=[]

            # margin of correct over best other among top5

            # worst-case competitor: max over vocab of (D_t - D_corr) + (lp_t - lpc); lp_t <= lp of others / top5 floor
            floor=float(tkl6[i,p,-1])
            dd=D[n]-D[n,corr]

            mask=torch.ones(V,dtype=torch.bool); mask[[t for t,_ in others]+[corr]]=False
            best_out=dd[mask].max().item()+floor-lpc

            flipsO.append((D[n,vt]-D[n,top]).item()+lpv-lp_top>0)
    return np.mean(flipsG), np.mean(flipsO), len(flipsG), len(flipsO)

def line_targets(SBl, Harr, target_p=0.95, K=1024):
    Ns=torch.tensor(np.stack([np.asarray(Harr[i,p],dtype=np.float32) for (i,p,_,_,_) in SBl])); tt=torch.tensor([x[2] for x in SBl])
    out_t=torch.zeros(len(SBl)); out_U=torch.zeros((len(SBl),4096))
    for s0 in range(0,len(SBl),256):
        N_=Ns[s0:s0+256]; t_=tt[s0:s0+256]
        Al=blogits(N_); ta=Al.topk(K,dim=1).indices; pa=torch.softmax(Al.gather(1,ta),-1)
        EL=torch.stack([pa[n]@LM[ta[n]].float() for n in range(len(N_))])
        Uw_=fnw*(LM[t_].float()-EL); Uw_=Uw_/Uw_.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True)
        Bl=blogits(fnw*Uw_); tb=Bl.topk(K,dim=1).indices
        subs=[]
        for n in range(len(N_)):
            u=torch.unique(torch.cat([ta[n],tb[n]])); u=u[u!=t_[n]]; subs.append(torch.cat([u[:2*K-2],t_[n:n+1]]))
        ml=min(len(x) for x in subs); sub=torch.stack([x[-ml:] for x in subs])
        As_=Al.gather(1,sub); Bs_=Bl.gather(1,sub); del Al,Bl; gc.collect()
        nf_=N_/fnw; c1_=(nf_*Uw_).mean(1); c2_=(Uw_*Uw_).mean(1)
        def lpf(t):
            rho=torch.sqrt(1+2*t*c1_+t*t*c2_); lg=(As_+t.unsqueeze(1)*Bs_)/rho.unsqueeze(1); return lg[:,-1]-torch.logsumexp(lg,1)
        lo=torch.zeros(len(N_)); hi=torch.ones(len(N_))
        for _ in range(8): ok=lpf(hi)>=np.log(target_p); hi=torch.where(ok,hi,hi*2)
        for _ in range(30):

        out_t[s0:s0+256]=hi; out_U[s0:s0+256]=Uw_

# Memory-efficient re-implementation of solve_stack (float32 big products, float64 small solves)
def solve_lean(Kp_, Kf_, ev, mu, eps, beta):
    a0=(1.0/(ev.double()+eps)).float()                      # (d,)
    # S = I/beta + Kf A0^-1 Kf^T
    S=torch.zeros(len(Kf_),len(Kf_),dtype=torch.float64)
    for i in range(0,len(Kf_),1024):
        S[i:i+1024]=((Kf_[i:i+1024]*a0)@Kf_.T).double()
    S+=torch.eye(len(Kf_),dtype=torch.float64)/beta
    KpA=Kp_*a0                                               # Kp A0^-1
    C=(KpA@Kf_.T).double()                                   # (p, f)
    Sinv_C=torch.linalg.solve(S, C.T)                        # (f, p)
    del S
    G=(KpA@Kp_.T).double() - C@Sinv_C                        # Kp A^-1 Kp^T
    M=torch.linalg.solve(G+torch.eye(len(Kp_),dtype=torch.float64)/mu, torch.eye(len(Kp_),dtype=torch.float64))  # (p,p)
    # Z = M (KpA - Sinv_C^T (Kf A0^-1))
    corr=(Sinv_C.T.float())@ (Kf_*a0) if len(Kf_)<=6000 else None
    Zout=M.float()@(KpA-corr)
    return Zout
